name: Tug Team
hook: Pull on the beat. Heave together. Drag them into the mud.
how: Two teams, one rope, a mud pit in between. Tap on the beat for a strong pull (off the beat is weak), keep a streak going for extra power, and when your whole team hits the same beat you HEAVE. Drag the flag past your line to win the round; best of 3.
controls: Space, any key or click on the beat; on touch, tap anywhere
uses: The host's browser adds up every pull, moves the rope and spots the heaves; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill both teams and tap close to the beat, but not perfectly.
Everyone hears the same beat and sees the same rope.
ideas: Make it a tug of war over a lava pit with dragons
Speed the beat up when the rope is near the middle
Add a power-up drum that doubles your team's pull for 5 beats
